- Josh Allen approached Pat McAfee on live TV. His reaction got fans talking
 
Josh Allen walked toward Pat McAfee before a Monday night NFL game, but the ESPN personality wanted to make sure the Buffalo Bills quarterback knew one important thing before he got too close: They were live.
McAfee repeatedly shouted "We're live" as Allen approached him on the field at U.S. Bank Stadium before the Bills played the Minnesota Vikings. According to Pro Football Network, McAfee issued the warning seven times before greeting Allen and wishing him good luck.
The brief interaction quickly became a talking point online. AOL reported that some viewers believed McAfee was simply trying to protect Allen from accidentally saying something into a live microphone. Other viewers thought the warning was unnecessary.
The clip drew plenty of reactions. One viewer wrote that McAfee was "a real one," while another said, "He protects his people," according to Pro Football Network. Others joked that Allen probably already knew he was on television.
